name: terminal_residual_shrinkage_v1
selection: one common alpha for seeds 42/43/44 per predeclared checkpoint family; minimize mean seed validation mean Euclidean error with predicted receiving hand on pure-future both-reference cohort
cohort: same frozen 60-sample stride-10 windows; only endpoints before first physical target aggregation capture and both reference wrists valid
validation_policy: export validation predictions only; verify original stored validation metrics; persist selection with validation/export/checkpoint checksums before opening any test prediction files
test_policy: reuse already frozen diagnostic exports; evaluate only alpha=0, alpha=1 and fixed validation-selected alpha; never rank or reselect alpha/checkpoint family on test
diagnostics: GT receiving-hand results and equal-recording means in addition to primary predicted-hand errors
limitations: Exploratory post-hoc experiment motivated by previously observed tests; test is not untouched
No true remaining time or distance to terminal target enters the attenuated prediction
A global scalar cannot correct an erroneous movement direction or infer when a hand is already at its unknown target
Overlapping windows are dependent; seed SD is not participant uncertainty
Selecting alpha on validation can overfit validation; test outcomes are reported without subsequent retuning
